agyos_skill.intent: Azure Storage File Share SDK for Python. Use for SMB file shares, directories, and file operations in the cloud.
agyos_skill.instructions: Manage SMB file shares for cloud-native and lift-and-shift scenarios. ```bash pip install azure-storage-file-share ``` ```bash AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING=DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=...;AccountKey=... AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_URL=https://<account>.file.core.windows.net ``` ```python from azure.storage.fileshare import ShareServiceClient service = ShareServiceClient.from_connection_string( os.environ["AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING"] ) ``` ```python from azure.storage.fileshare import ShareServiceClient from azure.identity import DefaultAzureCredential service = ShareServiceClient( account_url=os.environ["AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_URL"], credential=DefaultAzureCredential() ) ``` ```python share = service.create_share("my-share") ```
